subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open fork candidate for the Feishu reply-mention bug, or keep this issue open without queueing a new repair lane?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but an exact open fork candidate exists and the older same-repo PR had proof and safety blockers, so duplicating repair work without maintainer direction risks churn.

options.title: Repair or replace the candidate
options.body: Use the fork PR as context but land a target-repo current-main fix with bot-specific dropped-mention detection, scope-aware routing, tests, and live Feishu proof.

options.title: Ask the fork author to refresh
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the fork author to rebase into openclaw/openclaw and provide inspectable redacted Feishu proof.

options.title: Defer the Feishu reply fix
options.body: Leave this as an open known Feishu channel bug and do not queue a new repair lane until a maintainer can own the behavior.

recommendation.title: Repair or replace the candidate
recommendation.body: Use the fork PR as context but land a target-repo current-main fix with bot-specific dropped-mention detection, scope-aware routing, tests, and live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest current routing candidate from recent Feishu mention detector and test history.
